dedupe_keys.name: building damage field reconnaissance image dataset from the 2023 turkiye earthquake

description: Building Damage Field Reconnaissance Image Dataset from the 2023 Türkiye Earthquake is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Huili Huang, Georgia Institute of Technology (gatech.edu). This dataset contains 675 ground-level images documenting building damage caused by the 2023 Türkiye earthquake sequence. The images were collected in the field by domain experts from the Geotechnical Extreme Event Reconnaissance (GEER) association and the Earthquake Engineering Research Institute (EERI) during post-event reconnaissance missions. Coverage: Kahramanmaras, Türkiye. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: earthquake, post-event reconnaissance, computer vision, damage assessment, Türkiye Earthquake, expert-verified labels. Published 2026-05-29. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
